newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Benoni to buy computer firm, change name.
newsitem.headline: Benoni to buy computer firm, change name.

text.p: Benoni Gold Holdings Ltd said on Tuesday it will buy information technology firm Softline Holdings Ltd with effect from March 1.
It said the purchase price amounted to the aggregate of the net asset value and shareholders' claims against Softline of about 34.46 million rand, equal to 24.8 cents a share.
At the same time Benoni will change its name to Softline Ltd and apply to the Johannesburg Stock Exchange to transfer its listing to the electronics sector from cash companies.
Following the acquisition Benoni will change its year end to February 28, from March 31 currently.
It will also consolidate its issued share capital of one consolidated share of 10 cents each for every 10 existing Benoni shares of one cent each.

Benoni said after both the consolidation and acquisition its share earnings in the 12 months to end-February are expected to rise to four cents a share from 0.08 cents before either event took place. Earnings should rise further to six cents in 1997.
